content.title: About
content.content: Potato Tots NFS (item 4271) are small fried bites made from grated potato, breadcrumbs and seasonings. They have a crispy golden crust and a soft, slightly creamy interior. The product is designed for quick preparation in an oven or deep‑fryer and is commonly used as a snack or side dish.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Potato tots first appeared in the United States in the 1950s as a convenient way to use leftover potatoes.
The NFS brand is known for consistent flavor and texture across batches.
A small amount of corn starch is often added to make the tots extra crunchy.
They are frequently served with ranch dressing or ketchup in fast‑food settings.
Each 200 g package contains roughly 30–35 tots.

items.title: Source of carbohydrates
items.content: Potato tots provide a quick source of energy thanks to easily digestible carbs.

items.title: Contains vitamin C
items.content: A modest amount of vitamin C survives rapid frying, supporting the immune system.

items.title: Potassium
items.content: Potatoes are rich in potassium, important for fluid balance and muscle function.

items.title: Low sugar content
items.content: Unlike sweet snacks, tots have low levels of simple sugars.

items.title: Portion control
items.content: Their bite‑size shape helps manage calorie intake.

items.title: High fat content
items.content: When fried, tots absorb oil, increasing calories and saturated fat levels.

items.title: Sodium
items.content: Salt content can be high, which may be unsuitable for hypertension.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: Breadcrumbs often contain wheat; people with celiac disease should choose a gluten‑free version.

items.title: Trans fats
items.content: Using partially hydrogenated oils can lead to the formation of trans fats.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Cook the tots in a preheated oven at 200 °C for 12–15 minutes or deep‑fry for 3–4 minutes until golden. Serve hot with a dip, in burgers, salads, or as a standalone snack.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the unopened package in a dry, cool place away from direct light. After opening, transfer the tots to an airtight container and use within 5–7 days. Discard if a rancid oil smell develops.
